gap_records.summary: Required candidate file for `native_godot_project` is unverified.

acceptance_requirements: R02: movement, jump, dash, evade/roll, automatic step-up, and third-person camera work; facing, held/back-mounted equipment, and shoulder switching remain correct.
deferred_items: Combat, dialogue, progression, saving, and later chapter content remain deferred; they must not be used as evidence for R02.
implied_completion: Use ordinary declared inputs (WASD/mouse, Space, Shift, Alt/B) through a reachable MAP01-scale route rather than debug-only movement.
Verify wall slide/stop, small-step traversal, camera collision, model-forward alignment, and shoulder switching in rendered runtime states.
Start unarmed with unearned weapons hidden; verify hand/back mounting in the scoped equipment fixture without claiming full equipment progression.
mandatory_objectives: Deliver one candidate-bound, playable third-person locomotion slice in a compact authored MAP01-scale space.
Cover movement, jump, dash, evade/roll, automatic step-up, camera follow/collision, facing, and shoulder switching with runtime evidence.
Bind and verify the actor's idle, locomotion, jump, dash, and evade states plus the scoped hand/back equipment presentation.
task_specification.objective: Replace the bootstrap shell with a bounded first-playable third-person locomotion slice that fulfills the frozen R02 contract in a compact authored MAP01-scale route.

diagnosis.root_cause: The candidate is only a generated Godot bootstrap scene and project file, with no player controller, authored MAP01 space, character states, camera, collision, or equipment bindings needed to satisfy R02.

stop_conditions: Stop and report blocked if no qualified character, animation, or environment resource can be legally imported and bound after bounded comparison.
Stop and report unknown if host runtime replay or candidate-bound frame/state capture for review_r02 is unavailable; do not weaken R02 or substitute static screenshots.
Stop before expanding into combat, dialogue, progression, save systems, or additional chapters.

strategy.rationale: The candidate has no usable gameplay foundation. Build one coherent playable route and actor integration, adopting suitable qualified local resources after bounded comparison and preserving all R02 behaviors for one runtime review.

code: Project configuration and main scene resolve successfully, with declared ordinary input actions present and no missing scene/resource dependencies.
Player state transitions cover idle, locomotion, jump, dash, and evade/roll, and collision/step traversal are represented by reachable authored geometry.
runtime: Host/Tester independently replays review_r02 using ordinary input and captures candidate-bound runtime_state, frame, and source evidence for each required intermediate state.

Verify wall stop/slide, small-step auto-traversal, jump, dash, evade/roll, camera collision, both shoulder views, facing consistency, and the scoped hand/back equipment fixture; classify unavailable observations as unknown or blocked.
visual: Representative frames show a grounded, non-floating actor with model front aligned to movement, readable locomotion/jump/evasion poses, camera clearance from walls, consistent world view across shoulder switches, and correct hidden-unarmed versus hand/back equipment presentation.

done_when: In the authored MAP01-scale route, ordinary input moves and turns the player, and jump, dash, evade/roll, wall stop/slide, and small-step auto-traversal work while rendered idle/locomotion/jump/dash/evade states keep the model front aligned with movement.

The third-person camera follows and avoids geometry; left/right shoulder switching preserves world-facing and target direction, and the scoped unarmed/equipment fixture shows correct hidden-unarmed, hand-held, and back-mounted presentation without floating or scene intersection.
tasks.instructions: Implement the first playable R02 slice in the candidate. Replace the bootstrap main scene with a compact authored route that has a spawn, traversable path, wall/obstacle, and small ledge suitable for observing collision and auto-step behavior. Select and qualify a compatible third-person character, animation set, and environment source from the available pool; compare bounded alternatives, preserve provenance/license, and disclose the network-disabled limitation if external comparison cannot run. Bind the actor's idle, locomotion, jump, dash, and evade/roll states to actual movement rather than sliding a static model. Bind camera follow, collision avoidance, and shoulder switching so the model's visible front and world direction remain coherent. Keep the new-game state unarmed with unearned weapons hidden, and include only the minimal fixture needed to observe hand/back mounting. Configure ordinary inputs and ensure the scene launches through project.godot/main.tscn. Prepare the runtime scenario review_r02: start unarmed, move/turn, traverse the ledge, collide with the wall, jump, dash, evade/roll, toggle shoulders, and observe the equipment fixture. Tester/Host must independently capture candidate-bound runtime state, source, and representative frames for idle, locomotion, airborne, evasive, wall/step traversal, both shoulders, and hand/back presentation; report each behavior as pass, fail, blocked, or unknown.

investigation.expected_observation: The exact candidate files contain only a minimal scene and project configuration, so no existing controller or live resource binding can satisfy R02.
investigation.hypothesis: The primary blocker is missing candidate-owned gameplay and authored-resource bindings rather than a tuning defect in an existing controller.
investigation.probe: Inspect the exact candidate files, then perform a bounded local resource comparison and a minimal runtime launch probe before selecting bindings or expanding scope.

research_assessment.reason: The candidate is an empty Godot shell and the required third-person controller, camera collision, animation-state binding, and equipment mounts are unfamiliar and unverified. risk_note.validation: Run the bounded review_r02 sequence with independent runtime_state, frame, and source evidence, including adjacent wall/ledge and shoulder/equipment states; keep any failed or unavailable binding explicit.
